desc: The MOE SL AK Grip (MOE slim line) is a drop-in upgrade for AK47/AK74 pistol grips with a more vertical angle optimized for these shorter LOP weapons that bring the primary hand in closer to the shooter's body. With an aggressive TSP texture for positive weapon control along with modern ergonomics, the MOE SL AK grip provides a slightly smaller size and slimline feel compared to our full size grips. Made in U.S.A. grip counts as one US compliance part for 922r.
